meta.face: A Piedmontese priest of about seventy, clean-shaven, with a fair complexion and a LONG, LEAN face under a HIGH forehead — short, thick WHITE hair brushed back under the skullcap, deep-set, lively eyes CRINKLED with laughter lines under strong, straight brows, a LONG, straight, PROMINENT nose, deep creases running from the nose to the corners of the mouth, a WIDE, warm, closed smile, large, prominent ears and a firm chin; the head turned in three-quarter view, the gaze bright and kindly.
meta.basis: His photographs (Wikimedia Commons, from the Consolata's gallery; the Dicastery's portrait): a lean, long face with short white hair and a black skullcap, a long, prominent nose, deep-set, crinkled eyes, deep smile creases, a wide smile and prominent ears. The Consolata icon and shrine are the ones he served as rector from 1880.
meta.excerpt: His motto «Prima santi, poi missionari», as the Consolata Missionaries give it, with his words «Prima dobbiamo santificare noi… e fatti santi in poco tempo potremo compiere la nostra missione fra le genti» (consolata.org); our rendering (he died in 1926)
